title: TSE schedules Thursday hearing that could decide Rio election
seoTitle: TSE hears withdrawal of appeal on Rio election
subtitle: Superior Electoral Court set for next Thursday to analyze the candidacy for Rio de Janeiro governor.
excerpt: TSE set Thursday hearing to decide if Rio governor candidate Anthony Garotinho can withdraw his appeal.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has scheduled a hearing for next Thursday (the 8th) at 10 a.m. that could determine the course of the election for the governor of Rio de Janeiro.

The decision will focus on whether candidate Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) is entitled to withdraw an appeal he previously filed with the court.

Impact on the electoral process

Issues concerning appeals and withdrawals within the Electoral Justice follow procedures set out in the electoral calendar and the rules governing elections in Brazil. The progress of lawsuits of this nature is decisive for defining the legal status of candidates for major offices.

The anticipation surrounding the Thursday session stems from the potential impact the TSE’s ruling could have on the Rio race, given that the court is the highest instance of Brazil’s Electoral Justice for cases of this magnitude.

With information from Agência Brasil.
